title: Morning Prayer for Protection | Psalm 91 Over You and Your Family
description:
Start your day under God's protection. Pray Psalm 91 over yourself, your home and your family, then carry Psalm 91, Psalm 23 and Psalm 121 into your day.

Chapters
0:00 Good morning
0:41 Under his shadow (Psalm 91:1-2)
1:43 A strong tower (Proverbs 18:10)
2:14 Psalm 121:1-2
3:01 Let us pray
3:27 2 Thessalonians 3:3
3:54 Angels charged over you (Psalm 91:11)
5:20 Psalm 34:7
6:46 Whom shall I fear? (Psalm 27:1)
8:38 Isaiah 41:13
9:06 The armour of God (Ephesians 6:10-11)
9:31 Psalm 32:7
10:27 Deuteronomy 31:6
11:13 Declaration for today
11:36 I will be with him (Psalm 91:14-15)
13:26 Scripture to carry into your day
13:37 Psalm 91, read in full
16:01 The Lord is my shepherd (Psalm 23)
17:15 The whole armour of God (Ephesians 6:13-17)
18:22 I have called thee by thy name (Isaiah 43:1-2)
19:18 If God be for us (Romans 8)
20:21 In this will I be confident (Psalm 27:1-5)
21:42 A very present help (Psalm 46:1-3)
22:22 The Lord is thy keeper (Psalm 121)
23:28 One thing to do today
23:45 Blessing
